companyContext: L'Oréal is the world's largest cosmetics and beauty company, headquartered in Clichy, France. Through its Luxe division it operates a portfolio of prestige beauty houses including Lancôme, and invests heavily in skin-science research and beauty-tech devices.
brandContext: Lancôme is a French luxury perfume, skincare and cosmetics maison founded in 1935 by Armand Petitjean, part of L'Oréal's Luxury Products division. It is positioned as a high-end, Parisian house centered on care, happiness and feminine elegance, with the rose as its signature emblem.

typography.fontUses: Lancôme wordmark and primary brand name lockup — classic serif used for the iconic 'Lancôme' inscription with the circumflex over the ô
Secondary line of the logo ('PARIS') and product-line headings such as RÉNERGIE — modern bold caps that balance the serif wordmark
Editorial headlines and campaign typography across Lancôme communications and product packaging
Sub-headings, technical product descriptors ('NANO-RESURFACER | 400 BOOSTER'), and clinical claims
Body copy, ingredient lists, instructions for use and digital UI text
Long-form editorial body and caption text for a refined, airy feel

brandVision: Lancôme champions the 'power of care' — a Parisian vision of beauty as a force that uplifts women and transforms lives. With Rénergie Nano-Resurfacer 400 Booster, the maison extends this vision into beauty-tech, bringing professional-grade, microneedling-inspired performance into the home through 484 ultra-precise nano-tips that amplify the Rénergie H.C.F. Triple Serum for visibly younger-looking skin without pain or downtime.
brandValues: French elegance and timeless sophistication; scientific rigor and clinically proven efficacy; care, happiness and self-confidence for women; commitment to biodiversity, refillable/sustainable packaging and responsible consumption; empowerment of vulnerable women through education and entrepreneurship; heritage symbolized by the golden rose paired with cutting-edge innovation.
